description: Canonical |tr_M(β_atomic(Z, N))| at q_0 computed as Σ_λ y_λ(q_0) · χ^λ(β; q_0), the ~50-line combiner called out by `docs/audits/2026-05-17-knot-fusion-step1-audit.md` (PR #681). Consumes the symbolic χ^λ chi-cache from `per_irrep_pole_atom.py` and the 50-dps `y_lambda_at(n, q_0)` table. Partial chi caches yield truncated traces (`partitions_used < partitions_total`); downstream consumers should check `partial_cache` before using the result for the 1ppb comparison.
